prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 22 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1121; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was sideswiped while changing lanes. The patient reported immediate headache, dizziness, light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating, consistent with a diagnosis of concussion without loss of consciousness. Initial assessment included a neurological examination, cognitive screening, and vestibular and oculomotor testing, which revealed mild balance deficits and reduced visual tracking. A graduated return-to-activity plan was initiated, limiting screen time, reading load, and strenuous exertion during the acute phase.

Over the course of treatment, the patient completed 22 visits comprising physician follow-up, vestibular rehabilitation therapy, and cognitive rehabilitation sessions. Symptoms improved steadily, with headache frequency and dizziness decreasing substantially by the midpoint of care. Cognitive performance on repeat screening returned to near baseline, and balance testing showed significant improvement. At discharge, the patient reported minimal residual symptoms, occasional mild headaches with prolonged screen use, and was cleared to resume work duties with ergonomic accommodations. Continued home exercise and monitoring were recommended, with referral back for re-evaluation should symptoms recur.
